These terms cover your use of the Unpeel app and the unpeel.com website. Unpeel is made by an independent developer; the deal is meant to be as plain as the product: local software is free, and a paid subscription funds the service we operate.

## The free app

The Unpeel Mac app is free to download and use locally — no trial, no account, no license required.

## Unpeel Link and legacy Pro compatibility

Unpeel Link is a subscription of $59 per seat per year for the operated remote service: account/device identity and rendezvous as they roll out, the end-to-end encrypted relay, and push delivery. Unpeel 0.2 uses the Link name; earlier builds call the subscription **Unpeel Pro** and call its relay feature **Unpeel Remote**. The current activation flow delivers a signed license key that also unlocks the shipped iPhone/workspace surfaces (called Profiles in earlier builds). Those purchases, keys, and activations remain supported during migration.

For the currently released activation system:

- **One seat = one activated Host machine.** A Host may be the Mac app or the terminal UI on a Mac/Linux machine. You can deactivate it at any time (in Settings or from [your account](/account)) to free its seat for another machine.
- **Billed yearly.** Your seats stay active for as long as you're subscribed, and you can cancel anytime.
- **Updates.** All app updates are included for everyone, with or without Link.
- **What you may not do:** share, resell, or publish your license key; circumvent seat activation; or redistribute modified builds of the app.

The target Link model assigns one seat to one human account and separately
revocable personal devices. It will be covered by updated terms when that
sign-in flow ships; these terms do not pretend the unreleased account model is
already active.

We may revoke keys involved in fraud, chargebacks, or public sharing. Revocation for any other reason isn't something we do.

## Refunds

If Unpeel isn't for you, [send us a message](/contact) within 14 days of purchase and we'll refund you. We only ask that you tell us what didn't work.

## Third-party tools

Unpeel launches and manages agent CLIs (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, and others) that are separate products with their own terms, accounts, and pricing. You're responsible for your use of them, and Unpeel makes no promises on their behalf. The agents you run can execute commands, edit files, and (through the built-in MCP servers) browse the web — you're responsible for what you ask them to do and for reviewing what they produce.

## The software is provided "as is"

Unpeel is provided without warranty of any kind. To the maximum extent permitted by law, we're not liable for indirect or consequential damages — including anything an AI agent does under your direction — and our total liability is capped at what you paid for your subscription. Nothing in these terms limits liability that can't lawfully be limited.

## The website

Don't abuse the website or its APIs (scraping protected endpoints, probing, spam). Accounts manage purchases today and Link seats/devices as the account flow ships; they may be closed on request.

## Changes and contact

We may update these terms; material changes will be noted here with a new date, and the terms in force when you purchased keep governing that purchase. Questions: [use the contact form](/contact).
